selection: Two archived university courses with specific streaming/replay and lakehouse readings. These are selected units, not complete streaming-specialist degrees.
access_policy: Linked course pages and listed readings were publicly readable without login when verified. University enrollment, credit, grading, office hours and restricted resources are separate; no free enrollment or certificate is promised. No tuition purchase is needed for this lab. Original exercises below are not university assignment solutions.

courses.name: Distributed Systems
courses.age_context: Historical 2017 lecture, not a 2026 offering; some framework descriptions and terminology are dated. Use Flink 1.20 documentation for executable API semantics.
courses.prerequisites: Official: COS 217 required; COS 318, COS 333 and/or programming maturity recommended. Lab equivalent: Java basics, processes, key/value maps and aggregation.

public_materials.title: Lecture 21: Big Data Processing
public_materials.locator: Slide numbers printed on handout: 21–26 stateful streaming, 40–48 failure and replay; PDF pages 6–12 contain these slides.

courses.restricted_or_paid: Piazza and enrolled assessment are separate; no current enrollment availability or tuition checked.
courses.verification: Official course home and PDF opened successfully.

courses.name: Advanced Database Systems
courses.age_context: Archived 2024 course with designated streaming and lakehouse readings, not a claim of a 2026 course or a full Flink syllabus.
courses.prerequisites: Official: CMU 15-445/645 or equivalent database systems knowledge.

public_materials.locator: November 20 required reading; original paper sections 2–3. Course-hosted PDF link timed out during this review; original-paper university mirror separately verified.

supplements.year: versioned 1.20 docs (currently header 1.20.3); executable profile pins 1.20.2

supplements.locator: Motivation and event-time/completeness model. Context only: the checkpoint profile implements no watermark or late-data policy.

supplements.title: Kafka: a Distributed Messaging System for Log Processing

units.title: 01 · Events and replay / 事件与回放

reading.locator: Lecture 21 slides 41–43: record identity and replay

units.learning_goal_en: Predict physical writes versus unique event IDs. Count duplicate sequences from real output.
units.learning_goal_zh: 从真实输出区分物理写入次数与唯一事件。
units.expected: 8 unique IDs, 10 fault-run append rows; duplicate sequences 4 and 5.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: 8个唯一ID，故障组实际追加10行；重复序号为4和5。

units.title: 02 · Keyed state / 按 key 保存状态

reading.locator: Lecture 21 slides 23–26: retained state and aggregation

units.learning_goal_en: Hand-calculate every per-key prefix, then compare both Flink attempts.
units.learning_goal_zh: 手算逐 key 前缀和，核对两次 task attempt。
units.expected: All eight prefix totals match independent arithmetic; final A=56, B=68.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: 8个前缀累计值均匹配独立手算，最终A=56、B=68。

units.title: 03 · Consistent recovery / 一致恢复

reading.locator: Lecture 21 slides 47–48: source rewind and snapshot barriers; Flink Fault Tolerance tutorial

units.learning_goal_en: Locate completed checkpoint at offset 4, injection after seq 5, and restored source offset 4.
units.learning_goal_zh: 定位 checkpoint 完成、故障及从 offset 4 恢复的顺序。
units.expected: Completion precedes exception, which precedes restored=true at offset 4; only task-level recovery is tested.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: checkpoint完成先于异常，异常先于source以restored=true恢复到offset4；仅测试task级恢复。

units.title: 04 · External side effects / 外部写入

reading.locator: Lecture 21 slides 42–48 plus Flink tutorial: replay and external sink contract

units.learning_goal_en: Compare naive append sum with replay-safe keyed replacement. Explain why state checkpoints do not roll back external files.
units.learning_goal_zh: 对比追加求和与按 key 覆盖，解释 checkpoint 为什么不会回滚外部文件。
units.expected: Naive amount sum=160 vs oracle 124; keyed final values remain 56 and 68 under ordered single-writer assumptions.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: 普通追加金额求和160，独立预期124；在单写者、有序回放前提下，按key最终值为56和68。

units.title: 05 · Bounded reconciliation / 有界对账
units.learning_goal_en: Recompute from finite input. Corrupt one value while keeping the same key count and detect it by field comparison.
units.learning_goal_zh: 从有限输入重算；注入同 key 数量、错误字段的对照并检测。
units.expected: Equal row counts still pass on a deliberately corrupted copy; field-level equality fails. This Python counterexample is a model, not an Iceberg run.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: 故意损坏副本中的金额后，行数检查仍相等，字段比较失败。这是Python反例模型，不是Iceberg实测。

units.title: 06 · Feature freshness / 特征新鲜度

reading.locator: November 18 optional Lakehouse (2021), sections 2 and 3.1; November 20 Kafka (2011) sections 2–3

units.learning_goal_en: Treat per-key running amount as a feature. Compare a checkpoint-era view with the final view, then replay old feature versions through naive and monotonic consumers.
units.learning_goal_zh: 把逐 key 金额当成特征，对比旧位点与最终视图，再比较旧版本回放时普通覆盖与版本栅栏。
units.expected: At offset 4, A=16/B=20 are stale versus 56/68. A small explicit consumer model rejects older versions; no RAG retriever, model quality or paid AI API is tested.
units.engine_prerequisite: Run scripts/run_checkpoint_lab.py once. These exercises inspect actual engine output; audit/feature also include clearly labeled deterministic counterexample models.
units.expected_zh: offset4时A=16/B=20相对最终56/68已经陈旧；明确标注的消费模型拒绝旧版本，未测RAG检索器、模型质量或付费API。
